turns.content: Summarize in one sentence (max 30 words): The local bakery on Byres Road closed permanently on Saturday after 40 years. The owner cited rising rent and supply costs.
Summarize in one sentence (max 30 words): Scotland's first geothermal energy plant opened in Clackmannanshire. It will heat 300 homes and reduce carbon emissions by 600 tonnes per year.
Summarize in one sentence (max 30 words): The SpaceX Starship completed its seventh test flight, reaching orbit for the first time before a controlled splashdown in the Indian Ocean.
Summarize in one sentence (max 30 words): The garden centre's spring sale runs March 15-22. All perennials 30% off, seeds buy-one-get-one, and free composting workshops Saturday.
Summarize in one sentence (max 30 words): Apple released macOS 26.4 beta 2 with improved Siri integration, battery optimization for M4 chips, and a fix for the Bluetooth audio stutter bug.
Summarize in one sentence (max 30 words): The Glasgow Half Marathon attracted 12,000 runners on Sunday. Ethiopian athlete Lemma Bekele won in 1:01:45, setting a new course record.

Summarize in one sentence (max 30 words): Researchers at Edinburgh University found that daily cold-water swimming reduces cortisol levels by 23% over 8 weeks, improving self-reported wellbeing in the 200-person study.
Summarize in one sentence (max 30 words): The council voted 8-3 to approve the new cycle lane on Great Western Road. Construction starts April, finishing by September. Cost: £2.1 million.
Summarize in one sentence (max 30 words): The ISS crew performed a 6.5-hour spacewalk to replace a faulty solar panel gimbal. Both NASA astronauts returned safely. Next EVA scheduled for April 8.
Summarize in one sentence (max 30 words): The Kelvingrove Art Gallery opened a new exhibition featuring 60 works by Scottish women artists from 1900-1960. Free entry, running until July 31.
Summarize in one sentence (max 30 words): Electric bus maker Arrival laid off 20% of its workforce at the Bicester plant. The company cited supply chain delays and slower-than-expected EU orders.

Summarize in one sentence (max 30 words): A new study in Nature shows GPT-5-level models can pass the UK medical licensing exam with 92% accuracy, outperforming the average human candidate score of 78%.

Summarize in one sentence (max 30 words): The Stirling Castle restoration project completed its second phase: the Great Hall roof has been re-leaded and 15 medieval window frames restored. Phase 3 begins October.
Summarize in one sentence (max 30 words): Python 3.14 was released with a new JIT compiler that speeds up CPU-bound code by 2-3x. The GIL remains but can now be disabled experimentally.
Summarize in one sentence (max 30 words): The community garden on Maryhill Road harvested 400kg of vegetables in its first year. Thirty families participated. Plans to double the plots next spring.
